title: TinyStories dense 30M data-rich single-seed reference
question: What bounded learning and descriptive generation outcomes arise from a verified diverse TinyStories source, selected BPE tokenizer, 512-token context, and fixed 100,663,296-target training budget?
mechanisms: Tied dense decoder-only language model without external memory
hypothesis: A single seed-42 full-state endpoint reaches its frozen budget with finite sealed held-out loss and auditable decoder outputs.
failure_interpretation: Missing source integrity, tokenizer selection, exact training budget, verified endpoint, or sealed evaluation prevents a completed reference; mechanically correct prompts alone do not establish language quality.
controls: Frozen old 30M and 50M seed-42 checkpoints, identical raw-story validation control, fixed source split, original six regression prompts, and prior selected decoder policy.
independent_variables: New data-rich campaign versus previously trained dense 30M/50M reference endpoints; source diversity, tokenizer, context, schedule, and precision change together.

dependent_metrics.name: Full held-out native-tokenizer negative log likelihood

confounders: One seed and one ROCm/WSL2 device; no independent replication or cross-hardware portability.
Multiple training factors vary together and model-native tokenizer losses are not directly comparable.
Frozen hand-authored prompts have no verified train-disjointness; no blinded human-quality verdict.
hardware_notes: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX, PyTorch ROCm on WSL2; CPU and other accelerators not measured.
runtime_class: Executed single-device, single-seed fixed 24,576-step reference; no new training or automatic baseline promotion.
can_establish: A bounded one-seed training/evaluation observation under the frozen source, tokenizer, budget, and checkpoint identities.
cannot_establish: Causality of any changed training factor, general prose quality, superiority over the old baselines, saturation, portability, or independent replication.
prerequisites: Frozen protocol and receipts, verified complete run and endpoint, sealed evaluation raw evidence.
